create_broadcast_shape: create a function that broadcasts multiple tensor shapes together similar to numpy broadcast
build_unit_distribution: build a Unit distribution instance with a log_factor tensor for pyro factor statements
sample_unit_distribution: sample empty tensors from a Unit distribution using the sample method

expand_unit_distribution: expand a Unit distribution to a new batch_shape while preserving the log_factor
